summary: This episode of Ramadan Daily Tafseer focuses on Quranic verses prohibiting mockery among Muslims. Sheikh Ali Mashhour explains that mocking other people, whether men or women, is forbidden in Islam. The teaching emphasizes that those who mock others may actually be of lower status with Allah compared to those being mocked, and conversely, those being mocked may hold higher spiritual status. The lecture provides a comprehensive overview of the general prohibition against mockery and its specific application to interactions between Muslims of any gender.
